name: pria-tools
description: Pria agentic-VM in-VM tool extension: exposes search_knowledge (RAG/KAG vault search) and search_history (conversation history) to in-VM agents by calling Praxis's public REST API. Tier-1 prototype — no Pria backend code, stdlib only, API-key authenticated.

config.description: Pria API base URL. Defaults to https://pria.praxislxp.com.
Pria API key (pria_<40 hex chars>). Prefer PRIA_API_KEY env var.
